name: Blood Curse of the Adder's Kiss

description.value:
When you damage a creature with a weapon attack, you can afflict them with a magical venom. At the start of each of its turns, the affected creature takes poison damage equal to 2 x your Proficiency. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a Constitution Saving Throw. If the target suffers from the Poisoned condition, it makes this save with Disadvantage.

If it succeeds on the save three times, the venom's effect on it ends. Every time it fails the save - up until including the third time - the poison damage increases by 2 x your Proficiency. After the third failed save the poison lasts for 1 hour.

Amplify. The target cannot benefit from any healing while affected by the poison.
